status: Evaluation design only. The selected method and all executable source hashes must be frozen separately after development and before ANY new-source EVENT values are read.
development_sources: GECCO2018: all previous splits now disclosed
GECCO2019: all three chronological files now disclosed
scope: Previously unused historical external dataset. Method design used historically later data. This is not a simulated historical deployment without hindsight, a new site, or a MAWRID field test.
outer_periods: Six expanding contiguous deciles, k=4..9. Test conceptual interval [floor(N*k/10),floor(N*(k+1)/10)). Training and calibration use only source indices below the test start. The exact past training/calibration geometry is frozen with the selected method.
feature_history: At every calibration and test boundary, first120 rows are excluded and feature/policy state is reset. Missing input is never treated as evidence of normality. No centered windows or future interpolation.
baseline: Original v1 IsolationForest algorithm with original feature set, fitting rules, and threshold objective. Refit using the same past training and calibration intervals as V4. Also retain the old V1/V2/V3 results unmodified.
primary_event_metric: Confirmed new normal-to-alarm transition inside an original EVENT interval. Every original event, including unscorable events, remains in the denominator.
false_alarm_metrics: False alarm runs per eligible normal day
Fraction of eligible normal minutes under alarm
availability: Report native availability and intersection-of-availability comparisons; no event denominator reduction for unavailable events.
pooled_joint_improvement: On common available rows: confirmed detected events strictly exceed baseline AND false alarm runs/day strictly decrease AND normal alarm fraction does not increase. No metric substitution if this fails.
stable_joint_improvement: Pooled joint improvement plus, in EVERY one of the six periods, confirmed event count is at least baseline and both false alarm runs/day and normal alarm fraction are no greater than baseline. Event counts are not interpreted for no-event periods; false alarms still count.
operating_budget: Separately report whether EVERY period has <=1 false run/day and <=1% normal minutes under alarm. Passing calibration constraints is not a guarantee of passing future periods.
result_access: Do not inspect new-source outer outcomes until all six predictions and metric files have completed. After that single review, no retuning and repeated claim of unseen evaluation.
release_gate: No 3D integration in this task. If stability criteria fail, report the failure and preserve the candidate as experimental; do not promote based on the favorable pooled average alone.
labels: Original binary labels only. No point adjustment, relabeling, expanded events, forgiven tails, or mapping binary events into the five fault types.
